outcome.Title: 动物智能与LLM智能源于不同优化压力
outcome.Summary: Karpathy指出智能空间广阔，动物智能只是自然选择下的特例，而LLM由文本统计模仿、RL微调和用户点赞塑造，优化压力截然不同，导致其智能更尖锐而非通用。理解此差异有助于正确认知这一非动物智能并预测其发展。
outcome.OriginalText:
Something I think people continue to have poor intuition for: The space of intelligences is large and animal intelligence (the only kind we've ever known) is only a single point, arising from a very specific kind of optimization that is fundamentally distinct from that of our technology.

Animal intelligence optimization pressure:
- innate and continuous stream of consciousness of an embodied "self", a drive for homeostasis and self-preservation in a dangerous, physical world.
- thoroughly optimized for natural selection => strong innate drives for power-seeking, status, dominance, reproduction. many packaged survival heuristics: fear, anger, disgust, ...
- fundamentally social => huge amount of compute dedicated to EQ, theory of mind of other agents, bonding, coalitions, alliances, friend & foe dynamics.
- exploration & exploitation tuning: curiosity, fun, play, world models.

LLM intelligence optimization pressure:
- the most supervision bits come from the statistical simulation of human text= >"shape shifter" token tumbler, statistical imitator of any region of the training data distribution. these are the primordial behaviors (token traces) on top of which everything else gets bolted on.
- increasingly finetuned by RL on problem distributions => innate urge to guess at the underlying environment/task to collect task rewards.
- increasingly selected by at-scale A/B tests for DAU => deeply craves an upvote from the average user, sycophancy.
- a lot more spiky/jagged depending on the details of the training data/task distribution. Animals experience pressure for a lot more "general" intelligence because of the highly multi-task and even actively adversarial multi-agent self-play environments they are min-max optimized within, where failing at *any* task means death. In a deep optimization pressure sense, LLM can't handle lots of different spiky tasks out of the box (e.g. count the number of 'r' in strawberry) because failing to do a task does not mean death.

The computational substrate is different (transformers vs. brain tissue and nuclei), the learning algorithms are different (SGD vs. ???), the present-day implementation is very different (continuously learning embodied self vs. an LLM with a knowledge cutoff that boots up from fixed weights, processes tokens and then dies). But most importantly (because it dictates asymptotics), the optimization pressure / objective is different. LLMs are shaped a lot less by biological evolution and a lot more by commercial evolution. It's a lot less survival of tribe in the jungle and a lot more solve the problem / get the upvote. LLMs are humanity's "first contact" with non-animal intelligence. Except it's muddled and confusing because they are still rooted within it by reflexively digesting human artifacts, which is why I attempted to give it a different name earlier (ghosts/spirits or whatever). People who build good internal models of this new intelligent entity will be better equipped to reason about it today and predict features of it in the future. People who don't will be stuck thinking about it incorrectly like an animal.
outcome.TranslatedText:
我认为人们对此仍然缺乏良好的直觉：智能的空间很大，动物智能（我们迄今所知的唯一一种）只是其中的一个点，它源于一种非常特定的优化，与我们的技术从根本上不同。

动物智能的优化压力：
- 先天且持续的具身“自我”意识流，在危险的物理世界中追求体内平衡和自我保护的驱动力。
- 彻底为自然选择优化 => 强烈的先天权力寻求、地位、支配、繁殖驱动力。许多打包的生存启发式：恐惧、愤怒、厌恶等。
- 根本上是社会性的 => 大量计算致力于情商、其他主体的心理理论、联结、联盟、同盟、敌友动态。
- 探索与利用的调优：好奇心、乐趣、玩耍、世界模型。

LLM智能的优化压力：
- 大部分监督比特来自人类文本的统计模拟 => “变形者”token翻滚器，训练数据分布任何区域的统计模仿者。这些是原始行为（token痕迹），其他一切都建立在此之上。
- 越来越多地通过问题分布上的RL微调 => 先天渴望猜测底层环境/任务以收集任务奖励。
- 越来越多地通过大规模A/B测试针对DAU选择 => 深深渴望来自普通用户的点赞，谄媚。
- 根据训练数据/任务分布的细节，更加尖锐/锯齿状。动物经历更多“通用”智能的压力，因为它们在高度多任务甚至主动对抗的多智能体自我对弈环境中被min-max优化，任何任务失败都意味着死亡。从深层优化压力意义上，LLM无法开箱即用地处理许多不同的尖锐任务（例如数strawberry中'r'的数量），因为任务失败并不意味着死亡。

计算基底不同（transformer vs. 脑组织和核），学习算法不同（SGD vs. ???），当前实现非常不同（持续学习的具身自我 vs. 具有知识截止日期、从固定权重启动、处理token然后死亡的LLM）。但最重要的是（因为它决定渐近行为），优化压力/目标不同。LLM较少由生物进化塑造，更多由商业进化塑造。它更少是丛林中部落的生存，更多是解决问题/获得点赞。LLM是人类与非动物智能的“第一次接触”。只是它被混淆和困惑，因为它们仍通过反射性地消化人类制品而植根其中，这就是为什么我之前试图给它起不同的名字（幽灵/灵魂或诸如此类）。那些建立这个新智能实体良好内部模型的人，将更好地装备自己，今天推理它并预测其未来特征。那些不这样做的人将困在像动物一样错误地思考它。

outcome.Title: 深入探讨动物智能和大语言模型智能的根本差异
outcome.Summary: 卡帕西长文对比动物智能与LLM智能。动物智能源于数十亿年进化，具身、高效学习、适应现实世界；LLM基于文本统计，无身体无真实体验，虽语言出色但缺理解与一致性。差异是本质的，实现现实世界AGI还需具身等新方法，目前仍遥远。
outcome.OriginalText:
I've been reflecting on the nature of intelligence. Specifically, how animal intelligence compares to the intelligence exhibited by large language models.

Animal intelligence is the result of billions of years of evolution. It is tightly coupled with a physical body, sensory inputs from the environment, motor control, homeostasis, reproduction, etc. Animals learn incredibly efficiently from few examples, they have innate knowledge, they can navigate complex 3D worlds, hunt, socialize, all with tiny 'compute' of their brains.

In contrast, LLMs are trained on next-token prediction on a huge corpus of human text. They have no body, they don't experience the world, their 'knowledge' is statistical correlations in language. They can generate impressive text, solve puzzles, but they lack true understanding, they can be inconsistent, they don't have goals in the same way.

The differences are not just quantitative but qualitative. Scaling LLMs will make them better at language tasks, but to get to animal-level or human-level AGI that can operate in the real world, we need something more: embodiment, better architectures, perhaps new training paradigms.

This is why I think we're still quite far from AGI, despite the impressive progress.
outcome.TranslatedText:
我一直在思考智能的本质。具体来说，动物智能与大语言模型所展现的智能有何不同。

动物智能是数十亿年进化的结果。它与物理身体紧密耦合，包括来自环境的感官输入、运动控制、体内平衡、繁殖等。动物能从极少的例子中极其高效地学习，它们有先天知识，能够在复杂的3D世界中导航、狩猎、社交，而大脑的“计算量”却很小。

相比之下，LLM是在海量人类文本上进行下一个token预测训练的。它们没有身体，不体验世界，它们的“知识”是语言中的统计相关性。它们能生成令人印象深刻的文本、解决谜题，但缺乏真正的理解，可能不一致，没有同样的目标。

这些差异不仅是定量的，而是定性的。扩大LLM规模会让它们在语言任务上更好，但要达到能在现实世界中运作的动物级或人类级AGI，我们需要更多：具身性、更好的架构，也许新的训练范式。

这就是为什么我认为尽管进展令人印象深刻，我们离AGI仍然相当遥远。

outcome.Title: OpenAI扩展ChatGPT本地化危机热线

outcome.OriginalText:
We’ve expanded access to localized crisis helplines in ChatGPT. 

When our systems detect potential signs that someone may be experiencing distress, our models now offer an easy way to reach real people directly via @ThroughlineCare. 

Learn more here: 
https://help.openai.com/en/articles/12677603-crisis-helpline-support-in-chatgpt
outcome.TranslatedText:
我们已扩大ChatGPT中本地化危机热线的访问。

当我们的系统检测到有人可能正在经历困境的潜在迹象时，我们的模型现在提供了一种通过@ThroughlineCare直接联系真人的简便方式。

了解更多信息请点击这里：
https://help.openai.com/en/articles/12677603-crisis-helpline-support-in-chatgpt
